title: Puppy wearing a party hat
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Puppy body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='78' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- Body lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='82' rx='14' ry='9' fill='#f2d7a8'/>
  <!-- Front legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='82' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <rect x='58' y='82' width='8' height='14' rx='4' fill='#c98a4b'/>
  <!-- Paws -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='96' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f2d7a8'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='96' rx='6' ry='4' fill='#f2d7a8'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M74 74 Q86 66 82 54' stroke='#c98a4b' stroke-width='7' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='48' r='22' fill='#d99a5b'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='36' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#a86a2e' transform='rotate(-20 30 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='70' cy='36' rx='8' ry='14' fill='#a86a2e' transform='rotate(20 70 36)'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f2d7a8'/>
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='44' r='4' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='44' r='4' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='42.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59.5' cy='42.5' r='1.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2410'/>
  <!-- Mouth -->
  <path d='M50 55 Q46 60 43 57' stroke='#7a4a1a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 55 Q54 60 57 57' stroke='#7a4a1a' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tongue -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='61' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#e8778f'/>
  <!-- Party hat -->
  <path d='M36 30 L50 2 L64 30 Z' fill='#3fb8c9'/>
  <path d='M40 24 L50 6 L60 24 Z' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <path d='M43 30 L50 14 L57 30 Z' fill='#e8556d'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='4' r='4' fill='#ffd93b'/>
  <!-- Hat trim -->
  <rect x='35' y='27' width='30' height='6' rx='3' fill='#e8556d'/>
</svg>
